verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The build-through-staging delivery chain is exceptionally complete: signed protected source, all named build gates, immutable image and provenance, same-digest staging promotion, database ordering, deployment tests, staging failure handling, production approval, and signature verification are all represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The canary failure contract is not fully explicit: breached thresholds route to rollback but do not explicitly freeze rollout, and the compensation path omits the migration controller as the responsible actor.
verdict.coverage_summary: Weighted coverage is 65.5 of 69 possible weight (P = 0.9493). Thirty-eight of forty-two atomic requirements are fully represented. Consecutive-window semantics, explicit rollout freezing, migration-controller responsibility, and event-complete operator notifications are partial; none are absent or contradicted, so no cap applies.
